package main

import (
	"crypto/md5"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"sync/atomic"
)

// Identities the dependency handed the interpreter and the program never
// imported or spelled: hash.Hash behind md5.New (the program imports
// crypto/md5, not hash), and *sync/atomic.Uint64 from new(atomic.Uint64).

func main() {
	m := md5.New()
	io.WriteString(m, "abc")
	fmt.Printf("%x\n", m.Sum(nil))
	// Reassigning the hash.Hash variable sends the interface identity back.
	m = md5.New()
	io.WriteString(m, "abcd")
	fmt.Printf("%x\n", m.Sum(nil))

	a := new(atomic.Uint64)
	old := a.Or(0xaaa)
	fmt.Println(old, a.Load())
	a.Store(7)
	fmt.Println(a.Add(1))
	os.Exit(3)
}
